lead.headline: Love and Jefferson practise fully — the fallbacks stand down
lead.deck: Kamara stays limited in Paris; the lineup as set is the projection lineup.
lead.body: Start with the bad news: Alvin Kamara was limited again Thursday with his back (Saints report, Paris) and remains the fourth back. Everything else broke the right way. Jordan Love went full in a padded practice and says he is not missing Detroit (Packers.com, Yahoo 22 Oct); Justin Jefferson was upgraded to full (Vikings.com 22 Oct). This morning's two Friday fallbacks — Stafford for Kamara, Metcalf for Jefferson — are stood down. ESPN has AVIATO 60%, 130.8 to JuiceJam's 112.0.

doFirst.headline: Nothing to do — both injury questions answered
doFirst.deck: Love and Jefferson practised fully Thursday; the lineup as set is the projection lineup.
doFirst.note: Hold Fairbairn and the Broncos D/ST (both inside a point of the best free alternatives).
doFirst.empty: Nothing to fire this Thursday afternoon — Love and Jefferson both practised fully; Friday's report is the only remaining check.

roster.deck: The lineup as set is the projection lineup; no starter is in doubt after Thursday's practices.

wire.deck: Every riser fills someone else's vacancy and the weakest movable receiver is on the exposure list. Mayer is next week's tight end.
